name: float_power_tensor_scalar_
description: ATen schema aten::float_power_.Scalar(Tensor(a!) self, Scalar exponent) -> Tensor(a!). Computes float_power into self, returns the same Tensor object and storage, and preserves self shape and dtype. The scalar overload correctness suite covers deterministic inputs, scalar exponents and zero-sized tensors, output metadata, mutation and identity.
